verses.text: <pb/><e>Abù Ọma nke diri Onye-isi Abù; n'ubọ-akwara. Maschil Devid: mb͕e ndi Zif biara, si Sọl, Devid, ọ̄ dighi-ezo onwe-ya n'etiti ayi?</e> <pb/><t>Chineke, were aha-Gi zọputam,</t> <t>Were kwa idi-ike-Gi kpem ikpe.</t>
<t>Chineke, nuru ekperem;</t> <t>Ṅa nti n'okwu nile nke ọnum.</t>
N'ihi na ndi ala ọzọ ebiliwo imegidem, Ndi nēme ka madu ma jijiji achọwo kwa nkpuru-obim: Ha edoghi Chineke n'iru ha. Selah
<t>Le, Chineke bu onye nēyerem aka:</t> <t>Onye-nwe-ayi nọ n'etiti ndi nākwagide nkpuru-obim.</t>
<t>Ọ gēnyeghachi ndi nēchem anwu ihe ọjọ ha:</t> <t>Were ezi-okwu-Gi kpochapu ha.</t>
<t>M'gēji onyinye-afọ-ofufo churu Gi àjà:</t> <t>M'gēkele aha-Gi, Jehova, n'ihi na ọ di nma.</t>
<t>N'ihi na ọ bu na nkpab͕u nile ka Ọ naputaworom;</t> <t>Anyam elekwasiwo kwa ndi-irom.</t>
